description: Classify receipt OCR notes into structured receipt JSON. HTTP is unused when llm_role=classify.

output_schema.description: Receipt extraction from OCR notes and the goal. Always emit every required key. Use null when a value is not in the notes; do not invent. Set human_review_required when a receipt field is null or confidence is low.

merchant.description: Merchant name as printed, or null if missing. Copy from OCR notes; do not invent.

amount.description: Total charged, or null if missing. Use the receipt total, not tax alone.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code when stated, or null if the receipt does not name a currency.

date.description: Purchase date as YYYY-MM-DD, or null if missing. Convert printed dates to this form.

tax.description: Tax amount when printed, or null if not stated. Do not invent.

missing_information.description: Property names that are null or too unclear to extract. Empty array if complete.

confidence.description: Confidence score from 0 to 1 for the extraction as a whole.

human_review_required.description: True when a receipt field is null, confidence is low, or the notes are ambiguous.

human_review_reason.description: Why review is required, or null when human_review_required is false.
